fields.name: Configuration
fields.responsibility: Holds how the platform-neutral core learns where and how to connect: the inheritable connection-setting hierarchy that resolves into each read and write endpoint, the provider seam through which every platform-specific connection, command and transient-failure judgement is obtained, and the events the core reports to a host's logger. These belong together because they are what a host configures and observes before any query runs; it mirrors the Configuration section of the documentation.
